notes.title: Patch 1.04 - The Whole Story
notes.notes:
Update 1.04 includes a new room to explore, new ways to consume content, new help videos, hints and more Eyes of Mordechai to discover! We hope you enjoy this last major update for Murderous Muses, and from all three of us here, thank you for playing <3

[previewyoutube=GsJeBte74wQ;full][/previewyoutube]

PATCH NOTES
+ New replay room behind urn room
Full playback wall to show lifetime unlocked video memories
Suspect video screens that show related clips (fragments) together
Central TVs replay unlocked Mirlhaven's Unsolved Mysteries
+ Suspect lore plaques now activate to show video sequence that revealed painting
+ New hint TV video appears in tutorial first run, night one
+ New hint TV video appears in tips hotline from night two permanently
+ New restoration table in NightGallery1, which will appear for new playthroughs
+ New hints
+ New Eyes of Mordechai to find beyond staffroom 
.Disable hints in settings with 'skip tutorial'
.Sasha loan note removed to stop people trying to re-watch phonecall on reception TV
.Branched Higgins note to avoid confusion for players who knew how to solve police walls
.Staffroom only accessible from night 2 on first run, to avoid overwhelming some players
.Smoothed out the stairs collider in ball-roll puzzle to avoid player being caught on the bottom
.Fixed numeral indicators for branching and puzzle keywords to show the act they currently appear
.Fixed subtitle display for some Turkish characters
.Potential fix for Mac OS "hang on accuse" issue

notes.title: Patch 1.04 incoming & official tips video
notes.notes:
Patch 1.04 has hit final testing and brings with it a raft of new changes! 

These include a new room to discover with a way to watch all the videos you've ever unlocked, all the Mirlhaven's Unsolved Mysteries episodes and full sequences of related videos to help digest content:
[previewyoutube=Z4CnsaFE3vg;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also released an official tips video to help everyone get the most out of Muses (contains non-story spoilers):
[previewyoutube=aUHcNdEUzu4;full][/previewyoutube]

If testing goes well 1.04 should be out in the next couple of weeks!

notes.title: Patch 1.03 - Endgame
notes.notes:
Patch 1.03 is here and it's our biggest yet, with new stuff to try, find and collect...

[previewyoutube=i83QoGTnQTc;full][/previewyoutube]

+ Keyword Indicators
A new row of indicators will appear under the current keyword plaques from the second run onwards. These allow you to quickly find the videos you've never seen before.

+ Scorecard Icons
A new set of 31 suspect specific stamps have arrived to give your runs a rating, and will appear for everything in your run history so far.

+ Teleporter Chairs
New teleporter chairs have been added to each treasure room to quickly shift you back to reception. Or just run. The choice is yours!

+ Added Higgins voiceover hints to Urn room
+ Added new Higgins note to reveal new keyword indicators
+ FOV slider in settings now display vertical degrees
+ Camera sensitivity values below default are increasingly slower than before
+ Added first run message that spacebar (X button) toggles fullscreen video during playback

- Increased timeouts on phone puzzle to prevent confusion with controller focus
- Fixed shoulder inputs on controller to match direction of inventory movement and new indicators
- Fixed puzzle keys persisting in day mode if left at night
- Removed experimental VR code

notes.title: Dev update - the gallery is growing
notes.notes:
Here at D'Avekki Studios, we've been busy developing Murderous Muses and thought it was time to give you an update on our progress and what you’ll be able to do in game when it releases later this year.

[h2]No Ordinary Gallery[/h2]
Over the last couple of months, Sam and Tim have been focusing hard on bringing the 3D gallery to life and giving it a mind of its own by adding randomly generated rooms, spontaneously spawning paintings and clockwork exhibits to keep you guessing. The whole game might take place inside the gallery walls, but those walls don’t always stay in the same place! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309109/81820bf9f520da6b3af9d5358e96dc203db5e6ed.png[/img]

[h2]The Artist's Vision[/h2]
We’ve also been fleshing out the gameplay and adding loads of things for you to explore. You can discover the otherworldly origins of Mirlhaven Island and its lore - from the Headless Hearseman to the Undulating Hills - by finding and hanging paintings. Then, as the gallery shifts, you’ll encounter strange objects and puzzles that appear overnight, allowing you to unlock secret rooms that weren’t there before. And in the mysterious night exhibition, you can use the swirling ‘Eyes of Mordechai’ to bring paintings to life and see into the past, uncovering the final weeks of the artist and his muses in glorious full motion video! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309109/1ff78cd4b4a295a97daf28f59a5ae368e058db08.png[/img]

[h2]Framing a Murderer[/h2]
Which brings us to the heart of the game: the murder mystery - or rather, the murder [i]mysteries[/i]. The aim of the game is to work out who killed Mordechai Grey, but we want you to be able to replay it as many times as you like, without being able to tell ‘whodunit’ until the end. This means the murder mystery elements are shuffled whenever you start a new game. The murderer will be chosen at random from one of six potential suspects, along with three framing devices - the clues you’ll use to decide which muse is guilty. You won’t be able to work out who the murderer is until you’ve seen all three frames and revealed each suspect’s connection to them, meaning you can solve the mystery time and time again with no spoilers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309109/12d53f6112abcad2b0ccf494fa1998363994bed3.png[/img]

[h2]Sketchy Suspects[/h2]
But that’s only half the story. As well as getting to complete a murder investigation every time you play, you’ll also be unraveling parts of a much bigger puzzle, namely the secrets surrounding Mordechai Grey and his six muses. All of the suspects are very different, and each has their own tragic tale which you’ll need several playthroughs to reveal. There’s the ventriloquist who’s constantly outshone by his dummy, the criminologist pulling the strings of Mirlhaven’s most wanted, the grief-stricken burlesque dancer making all the wrong choices, the perky undertaker with a taste for the macabre, the clockmaker who’s too tightly wound for his own good, and the tennis twins desperate to escape their family curse. Tim and Lynda have been busy writing these scripts over the last couple of months and we’re getting ready to begin casting at the end of this month so watch this space!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41309109/4c3e526951e52a58fe2f55793c127824ce00cb06.png[/img]

We can’t wait to show you more - including features we haven’t even mentioned yet! - but we’ll save some things for another update. In the meantime, if you want to keep tabs on our progress, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/davekki]Twitter[/url] and please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727270/Murderous_Muses/]wishlist[/url] the game below!
